name: siteguard
description: SiteGuard: website security monitoring. Root scripts build and test both the backend and the frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:ci: npm --prefix backend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run check:node && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run db:check && npm test && npm run build
